test_type: Bug Fix Verification: BUG-018 Push Status Labels
summary: BUG-018 verified as fixed. Push status now shows accurate counts from push_summary API (e.g., '42 items not pushed') instead of old misleading '125 items behind'. Labels are amber-colored, not red. Synced stores show green 'Synced' label.

features_tested.feature: BUG-018 A1: Store Management page loads with accurate push counts from push_summary

features_tested.feature: BUG-018 A2: Synced stores show green 'Synced' label
